title: 决定性瞬间
creator: Henri Cartier-Bresson
note: 布列松把「决定性瞬间」变成摄影的方法论：在流动的街头等几何与时机同时闭合的那一帧。
noteEn: Cartier-Bresson turned "the decisive moment" into a method: waiting for geometry and timing to close in one flowing frame.

title: 圣拉扎尔车站后
creator: Henri Cartier-Bresson
note: 跃过水洼的男子与身后海报女郎剪影几乎悬空呼应，被奉为抓拍的圣像。
noteEn: A man leaping over a puddle answers the dancer on the poster—canonised as the icon of the candid shot.

title: 市政厅之吻
en: Le Baiser de l'Hôtel de Ville
creator: Robert Doisneau
note: 巴黎街头拥吻的定格，多年后才承认是摆拍，却依旧是浪漫街拍的代名词。
noteEn: A kiss on a Paris street, later admitted staged—still the emblem of romantic street photography.

title: 纽约
creator: William Klein
note: 粗颗粒、广角变形与运动模糊，把街头摄影从优雅里一把拽出来。
noteEn: Grain, wide-angle distortion and blur yanked street photography out of its elegance.

title: 女人是美丽的
creator: Garry Winogrand
note: 倾斜的取景框追逐纽约街头的女性，能量与失衡并存。
noteEn: Tilted frames chase women on New York streets—energy born of imbalance.

title: 动物
creator: Garry Winogrand
note: 动物园里人与动物隔着栅栏的对峙，全是错位与荒诞。
noteEn: People and animals face off at the zoo—all misalignment and absurdity.

title: 在街上
creator: Helen Levitt
note: 哈莱姆街头孩子的粉笔画与游戏，被拍得像俳句一样轻。
noteEn: Chalk drawings and games of children in Harlem, shot light as haiku.

title: 早期色彩
creator: Saul Leiter
note: 1950年代纽约的雨窗、伞与霓虹，色彩暧昧而克制，生前几乎无人知晓。
noteEn: Rain-washed windows, umbrellas and neon in 1950s New York—colour both hazy and restrained, unseen for decades.

title: 街头自拍
creator: Vivian Maier
note: 保姆身份拍下逾十万张底片，死后才被发掘，影子里反复出现的自拍最迷人。
noteEn: A nanny left over 100,000 negatives found posthumously—her shadow self-portraits are the most haunting.

title: 靠近的影子
creator: Fan Ho
note: 香港旧楼间的光影几何，构图精练得像版画，是何藩最出圈的一张。
noteEn: Light and geometry between old Hong Kong tenements, composed like a woodcut—Fan Ho's best-known frame.

title: 影之城
creator: Alexey Titarenko
note: 圣彼得堡的长曝光把人流拖成幽灵般的灰影，街头变成时间的河床。
noteEn: Long exposures in St. Petersburg drag crowds into ghostly grey streaks—the street as a riverbed of time.

title: 告别摄影
creator: Daido Moriyama
note: 过曝、失焦、粗颗粒的激进自否，森山大道式「粗糙、模糊、失焦」的宣言书。
noteEn: A radical self-negation of overexposure, blur and grain—the manifesto of Moriyama's "are, bure, boke".

title: 流浪狗
creator: Daido Moriyama
note: 一只回头的流浪狗被他认作自己的自画像，成为都市疏离的图腾。
noteEn: A stray dog glancing back read as a self-portrait—an icon of urban alienation.

title: 海地
creator: Bruce Gilden
note: 直怼人脸的闪光灯人像，粗暴却充满生命力，把街头逼近到冒犯。
noteEn: In-your-face flash portraits, brutal yet brimming with life—street photography pushed into provocation.

title: 狗（杂种）
creator: Elliott Erwitt
note: 蹲到狗的高度看世界，幽默全藏在巧合里，狗成了他的签名。
noteEn: Shooting at dog's-eye height, humour hiding in coincidence—dogs became his signature.

title: 阅读中
creator: André Kertész
note: 全球街头读书人的侧影，安静而专注，构成一部世界阅读群像。
noteEn: Absorbed readers on streets around the world—a quiet, global portrait gallery of reading.

title: 光的苦难
creator: Alex Webb
note: 加勒比与墨西哥的浓烈色彩，复杂构图层层嵌套，每帧都像解谜。
noteEn: Dense colour from the Caribbean and Mexico, compositions nested like puzzles.

title: 午夜前的几分钟
creator: Trent Parke
note: 横穿澳洲九万公里的黑白公路片，把澳大利亚拍得黑暗而炽烈。
noteEn: A 90,000 km road trip across Australia in brooding black and white—the nation rendered dark and incandescent.

title: 最后的度假地
creator: Martin Parr
note: 英国海滨度假区的彩色俗艳，是放大中产庸常的加味镜。
noteEn: Acid colour at a British seaside resort—a magnifying lens on the mundane.

title: 人行道
creator: Jeff Mermelstein
note: 纽约人行道上电话与私语的瞬间，像在城市里偷听。
noteEn: Moments of phones and whispers on New York sidewalks—eavesdropping on the city.

title: 色彩之河
creator: Raghubir Singh
note: 恒河岸边的印度街头，彩色饱和得近乎欢腾，打破黑白街头定式。
noteEn: Indian street life by the Ganges, colour saturated almost to jubilance—breaking the black-and-white mould.

title: 现代色彩
creator: Fred Herzog
note: 1950年代就用柯达克罗姆拍温哥华街头，比彩色摄影主流早了二十年。
noteEn: Kodachrome street scenes of 1950s Vancouver, decades ahead of the mainstream colour movement.

title: 自拍像
creator: Lee Friedlander
note: 影子、橱窗与反光里的自己，街头与自恋叠成一张复杂的底片。
noteEn: The self in shadows, shop windows and reflections—street-flavoured self-obsession on one complex negative.

title: 想一想英格兰
creator: Matt Stuart
note: 伦敦街头的巧合错位，幽默藏在三次快门之间。
noteEn: Coincidental collisions on London streets—humour hiding between three quick frames.

title: 美国表象
creator: Stephen Shore
note: 公路旅行沿途的平凡桌面与街角，把彩色快照抬进美术馆。
noteEn: Ordinary tabletops and street corners along a road trip—snapshot aesthetics elevated to the museum.

title: 巴黎之夜
creator: Brassaï
note: 深夜巴黎的雾、煤气灯与情侣，把夜生活拍成一座地下宫殿。
noteEn: Fog, gaslight and lovers in night Paris—the nocturnal city as an underground palace.

title: 舵楼
creator: Alfred Stieglitz
note: 三等舱甲板上的人群被抽象成几何，被视作现代摄影的分水岭。
noteEn: Passengers on the steerage deck abstracted into geometry—a watershed of modern photography.

title: 华尔街
creator: Paul Strand
note: 金融区街角穿黑衣的上班族排成抽象剪影，现代主义摄影的序章。
noteEn: Black-coated clerks at a Wall Street corner—abstraction before its time.

title: 美国影像
creator: Walker Evans
note: 大萧条美国的面孔与店铺，冷静到近乎文献，却处处是诗。
noteEn: Faces and storefronts of Depression-era America, cool to the point of archive yet quietly poetic.

title: 美国人
creator: Robert Frank
note: 两万七千张底片炼成的「别样的美国」，彻底改写了街头与纪实的语法。
noteEn: 27,000 frames distilled into a different America that rewired the grammar of street and documentary.

title: 芝加哥
creator: Harry Callahan
note: 多重曝光与极简构图把芝加哥的日常抽成黑白几何，妻女是永远的主角。
noteEn: Multiple exposures and stark minimalism abstract Chicago's everyday—his wife and daughter the eternal subjects.

title: 迁徙的母亲
creator: Dorothea Lange
note: 大萧条营地里的母亲，一根皱紧的眉成为整整一个时代的脸。
noteEn: A mother in a Depression camp—one furrowed brow became the face of an era.

title: 双胞胎
creator: Diane Arbus
note: 一模一样却气质迥异的两姐妹，凝视里长出了不安。
noteEn: Identical yet utterly different sisters—unease staring out of the frame.

title: 美国西部
creator: Richard Avedon
note: 灰底影棚前直视镜头的矿工、牛仔，把肖像剥离成人的本质。
noteEn: Miners and cowboys staring into a grey studio backdrop—portraiture stripped to its essence.

title: 创世纪
creator: Sebastião Salgado
note: 八年走访全球最原始的角落，把尚未被文明触碰的自然拍成黑白史诗。
noteEn: Eight years across the planet's untouched corners—pristine nature shot as a black-and-white epic.

title: 劳动者
creator: Sebastião Salgado
note: 煤矿、油田与手工作坊里被汗水和体力定义的肉身，劳动的纪念碑。
noteEn: Mines, oil fields and workshops—bodies defined by sweat and muscle, a monument to labour.

title: 斯卡诺
creator: Mario Giacomelli
note: 高反差把意大利山村的黑衣人剪成几何图形，近乎抽象表现主义。
noteEn: High contrast cuts black-clad figures in an Italian mountain village into geometry—near Abstract Expressionism.

title: 工作室之窗
creator: Josef Sudek
note: 数十年凝视同一扇窗，光在玻璃与雾气上画水彩。
noteEn: Decades of the same window—light painting watercolours on glass and fog.

title: 人类的大家庭
creator: Edward Steichen
note: 273位摄影师、503张照片的史诗展览，冷战年代「人同此心」的最大证明。
noteEn: An epic exhibition of 503 prints by 273 photographers—a Cold War testament to shared humanity.

title: 平顶大厦
creator: Edward Steichen
note: 雨雾中湿漉漉的熨斗大厦，画意摄影最著名的浪漫剪影。
noteEn: The Flatiron in rain and fog—the most famous romantic silhouette of Pictorialism.

title: 纽约变迁
creator: Berenice Abbott
note: 在旧纽约被拆掉之前，用大画幅相机为它的街巷立传。
noteEn: Large-format portraits of old New York, made before demolition erased it.

title: 乡间医生
creator: W. Eugene Smith
note: 与科罗拉多乡村医生同吃同住数周，把照片故事（photo essay）推到巅峰。
noteEn: Weeks living with a rural Colorado doctor—the photo essay pushed to its peak.

title: 水俣
creator: W. Eugene Smith
note: 母亲为患水俣病的女儿沐浴的经典画面，他为此被厂方打伤也不放手。
noteEn: The famous bath scene of a mercury-poisoned girl—he was beaten for the photos and would not stop.

title: 裸体的透视
creator: Bill Brandt
note: 广角畸变把人体变成起伏的丘陵，超现实的黑白地貌。
noteEn: Wide-angle distortion turns the body into rolling hills—surreal monochrome terrain.

title: 胡椒 No.30
creator: Edward Weston
note: 一颗青椒被拍出雕塑般的曲线，证明照片能抵达物的本质。
noteEn: A single pepper rendered as sculpture—proof that a photograph can reach a thing's essence.

title: 温斯顿·丘吉尔
creator: Yousuf Karsh
note: 夺走雪茄换来的怒目而视，成了英国不愿屈服的象征。
noteEn: The snatched cigar earned a glare that became Britain's defiance.

title: 塞拉佩拉达
creator: Sebastião Salgado
note: 五万淘金者挤在巨大矿坑里如蚁群般攀爬，劳动者的地狱图景。
noteEn: 50,000 gold miners swarming a vast open pit, climbing like an ant colony—a hellscape of labour.

title: 春树奇峰
creator: Lang Jingshan
note: 用多张底片在暗房合成的水墨山水，集锦摄影的开山之作。
noteEn: A darkroom composite of multiple negatives turned into ink-wash landscape—the origin of "composite photography".

title: 老巴黎
creator: Eugène Atget
note: 赶在现代化前，为旧巴黎的店铺与街巷留下一整座影像档案馆。
noteEn: An archive of old Paris storefronts and streets, made before modernisation swept them away.

title: 被人遗忘的人
creator: Lü Nan
note: 1989-90年走访38家精神病院，用三年时间把尊严还给被遗忘者。
noteEn: Three years inside 38 psychiatric hospitals (1989-90) that gave dignity back to the forgotten.

title: 麦客
creator: Hou Dengke
note: 关中麦客候鸟般迁徙割麦，黄土高原上一个人的史诗。
noteEn: Migrant wheat-cutters crossing the Guanzhong plain—one man's epic of the loess plateau.

title: 提顿山与蛇河
en: The Tetons and the Snake River
creator: Ansel Adams
note: 区域曝光法把山脉与河流压成层次分明的乐章，美国西部的圣像。
noteEn: The Zone System turns mountain and river into a clearly-articulated symphony—the American West's icon.

title: 清除冬季风暴
creator: Ansel Adams
note: 风暴初歇的约塞米蒂，云与花岗岩的剧烈对照。
noteEn: Yosemite as the storm lifts—a stark play of cloud against granite.

title: 白杨
creator: Ansel Adams
note: 逆光的白杨树皮近乎抽象，银盐质感被拉到极致。
noteEn: Backlit aspen trunks verging on abstraction—silver gelatin at its finest.

title: 月亮与半圆丘
creator: Ansel Adams
note: 满月悬在花岗岩穹顶之上，精准到像一次天文计算。
noteEn: A full moon poised over granite domes—precise as celestial calculation.

title: 波因特洛沃斯
creator: Edward Weston
note: 岩石与海水的形态被拍成雕塑般的纹理，一生凝视同一片海岸。
noteEn: Rocks and surf reduced to sculptural form and texture—a lifetime at one coastline.

title: 海景
creator: Hiroshi Sugimoto
note: 长曝光把海天各压成一半灰阶，时间在其中静止成永恒。
noteEn: Long exposures split sea and sky into equal halves—time suspended into eternity.

title: 制造的风景
creator: Edward Burtynsky
note: 采石场、废船厂与油矿，人类工业在土地上刻下的宏大伤疤。
noteEn: Quarries, ship-breaking yards and oilfields—the monumental scars industry leaves on the land.

title: 沙漠组歌
creator: Richard Misrach
note: 把美国西南沙漠当成一场持续数十年的摄影实验，荒芜里全是政治。
noteEn: The American Southwest desert as a decades-long photographic experiment—politics hiding in the emptiness.

title: 北海道
creator: Michael Kenna
note: 雪原上的孤树与冰面，极简到只剩下呼吸，长曝光把雪抹成缎子。
noteEn: Lone trees and ice fields in snow, reduced to breath—long exposure turns snow to silk.

title: 天域黄山
creator: Wang Wusheng
note: 以水墨笔意拍黄山云海，把东方山水翻译成银盐黑白。
noteEn: Huangshan clouds shot with ink-wash intent—Eastern landscape redeveloped in silver.

title: 野性即世界的保存
en: In Wildness Is the Preservation of the World
creator: Eliot Porter
note: 彩色森林细节配上梭罗语录，环保摄影里程碑式的图文书。
noteEn: Colour close-ups of the wild paired with Thoreau—a milestone of conservation photography.

title: 山光
creator: Galen Rowell
note: 在极限山野追光，一瞬的光线决定一张照片的生死。
noteEn: Chasing light across extreme mountain terrain—a single instant decides a frame's fate.

title: 我们被禁止的土地
creator: Fay Godwin
note: 在「禁止进入」的英国旷野上行走拍摄，把风景拍成了政治。
noteEn: Photographing Britain's fenced-off moors—landscape turned into politics.

title: 静谧之光
creator: John Sexton
note: 继承亚当斯的区域曝光法，专拍清晨的雾与微光。
noteEn: The Zone System's heir, photographing dawn light and fog.

title: 苏格兰之光与土地
en: Scotland: The Light and the Land
creator: Colin Prior
note: 大画幅相机把苏格兰高地拍得壮阔而纯净，像地球的骨架。
noteEn: Large-format clarity across the Scottish Highlands—the planet's bare bones.

title: 对视
creator: Frans Lanting
note: 野生动物肖像直视镜头，仿佛隔着纸页与人对视。
noteEn: Wildlife portraits that look straight back—eye contact across the page.

title: 约塞米蒂河谷
creator: Carleton Watkins
note: 19世纪用巨型湿板相机拍约塞米蒂，直接推动了国家公园的建立。
noteEn: Mammoth wet-plate views of Yosemite in the 19th century that helped create the national parks.

title: 峡谷地古城遗址
en: Ancient Ruins in the Canyon de Chelle
creator: Timothy O'Sullivan
note: 内战后西部勘探摄影的产物，岩壁与废墟有一种惊人的现代感。
noteEn: A product of post-Civil War survey photography—cliffs and ruins startlingly modern in feel.

title: 莱茵河 II
creator: Andreas Gursky
note: 数码抹平后的莱茵河只剩几条水平线，2011年以430万美元成为当时最贵照片。
noteEn: A digitally flattened Rhine reduced to horizontals—it sold for $4.3M in 2011, then the priciest photograph ever.

title: 新西部
creator: Robert Adams
note: 不动声色地拍科罗拉多被扩张吞噬的郊区，把「新地形学」变成现实。
noteEn: Unblinking frames of Colorado suburbs overtaken by sprawl—New Topographics made real.

title: 高原之光
creator: David Muench
note: 大画幅彩色拍科罗拉多高原，美国西部风景明信片美学的源头。
noteEn: Large-format colour of the Colorado Plateau—the source of the American West's postcard grandeur.

title: 新地形学
creator: Robert Adams, Lewis Baltz et al.
note: 1975年罗切斯特的展览，用中性目光拍无人的郊区与工业带，终结了风景的浪漫。
noteEn: The 1975 Rochester show that looked at unpeopled suburbs and industrial strips with a deadpan eye, ending landscape's romance.

title: 无人知晓之地
creator: Eliot Porter
note: 格伦峡谷被水库淹没前的彩色挽歌，一张照片也无法让水坝回头。
noteEn: A colour elegy for Glen Canyon before the dam drowned it—photography that could not turn the water back.

title: 地球升起
creator: William Anders
note: 阿波罗8号绕月时拍下地球从月平线升起，环保与太空时代的双重图腾。
noteEn: Earth rising over the lunar horizon from Apollo 8—an icon of both ecology and the space age.

title: 约翰·列侬与小野洋子
creator: Annie Leibovitz
note: 滚石封面那张列侬蜷曲亲吻洋子的照片，拍后数小时他遇刺身亡。
noteEn: The Rolling Stone cover of Lennon curled against Ono—shot hours before his murder.

title: 黛米·摩尔
creator: Annie Leibovitz
note: 怀孕裸照登上《名利场》封面，引爆了身体与封面文化的争论。
noteEn: A nude pregnant Demi Moore on Vanity Fair—igniting debates on the body and magazine covers.

title: 阿富汗少女
creator: Steve McCurry
note: 绿眼睛难民少女登上《国家地理》封面，成了全世界最熟悉的难民之脸。
noteEn: The green-eyed refugee girl on National Geographic's cover—the world's most familiar face of exile.

title: 小商贩
creator: Irving Penn
note: 巴黎与伦敦的屠夫、面包师站在灰色背景前，每个职业都有尊严。
noteEn: Paris and London tradespeople posed against grey—the dignity of craft, one trade at a time.

title: 斯特拉文斯基
creator: Arnold Newman
note: 钢琴盖像帽子一样扣住作曲家，环境肖像的教科书。
noteEn: A piano lid framing the composer like a hat—the environmental portrait perfected.

title: 玛丽莲·梦露
creator: Eve Arnold
note: 镁光灯下的倦怠，明星面孔背后藏着一层脆弱。
noteEn: Weariness under the lights—the fragility behind the star.

title: 街头智慧
creator: Mary Ellen Mark
note: 西雅图街头的流浪少年，「小老鼠」的凝视久久不散。
noteEn: Runaway teens in Seattle—the gaze of "Tiny" lingers long after the page turns.

title: 多薇玛与大象
creator: Richard Avedon
note: 高定时装与马戏团大象的荒诞对置，时尚摄影的永恒杰作。
noteEn: Haute couture against circus elephants—an enduring masterpiece of fashion photography.

title: 默克尔岁月
creator: Herlinde Koelbl
note: 三十年间同一机位拍默克尔，权力与衰老一起写在脸上。
noteEn: Thirty years of Merkel in the same framing—power and ageing written on one face.

title: 二十世纪的人
creator: August Sander
note: 按职业分类的德国社会档案，被纳粹视为危险而禁售。
noteEn: A social archive of Germany classified by occupation—banned by the Nazis as dangerous.

title: 阿尔弗雷德·丁尼生
creator: Julia Margaret Cameron
note: 柔焦湿板里的桂冠诗人，摄影争取艺术身份的早期证明。
noteEn: A soft-focus wet-plate poet laureate—photography claiming its place as art.

title: 莎拉·伯恩哈特
creator: Nadar
note: 19世纪名流的「肖像圣殿」，作者本人还是乘气球航拍巴黎的第一人。
noteEn: A 19th-century temple of celebrity portraits, by a photographer-aeronaut who also made Paris's first aerial shots.

title: 感伤之旅
creator: Nobuyoshi Araki
note: 蜜月途中私拍妻子阳子，日本「私摄影」的起点。
noteEn: Intimate photos of his wife Yoko on their honeymoon—the origin of Japanese "private photography".

title: 我们这一代
creator: Xiao Quan
note: 记录崔健、张艺谋等一代文化名人，一个时代的精神群像。
noteEn: Portraits of Cui Jian, Zhang Yimou and a generation—the psyche of an era in one book.

title: 超级名模
creator: Peter Lindbergh
note: 一月号群像把五位超模拍成素颜伙伴，九十年代时尚的开场白。
noteEn: The January cover shot of five supermodels barefaced—the opening statement of 1990s fashion.

title: 特写
creator: Martin Schoeller
note: 明星与普通人的「大头照」，同一盏灯抹平了所有等级。
noteEn: Celebrities and strangers as "big heads"—one light erases all hierarchy.

title: 达利的原子
creator: Philippe Halsman
note: 六小时、28次跳跃与泼水，才定格下达利与猫同时悬空的一瞬。
noteEn: Six hours, 28 jumps and flying water to freeze Dalí and the cats mid-air.

title: 黑与白
creator: Man Ray
note: 非洲面具与基基的脸并置，超现实主义肖像的经典。
noteEn: An African mask beside Kiki's face—a classic surrealist portrait.

title: 琼·哈洛
creator: George Hurrell
note: 好莱坞黄金时代的光影把明星拍成神，一代影人的造像标准。
noteEn: Hollywood's golden-age lighting that shot stars as gods—the standard for a generation of glamour.

title: 性依赖的叙事曲
creator: Nan Goldin
note: 快照式私影像记录波西米亚圈的爱与暴力，幻灯片放映成为仪式。
noteEn: Snapshot-style images of a bohemian circle—love and violence in a slide-show ritual.

title: 海滩肖像
creator: Rineke Dijkstra
note: 青春期少年少女站在海边，姿态与不安暴露无遗。
noteEn: Adolescents at the shore—posture and unease laid bare against the sea.

title: 厨房餐桌系列
creator: Carrie Mae Weems
note: 自导自演的餐桌场景，把种族与性别叙事搬上家庭剧场。
noteEn: Self-directed scenes at a kitchen table—a domestic theatre of race and gender.

title: 另一半人怎么活
creator: Jacob Riis
note: 用镁光闪进纽约贫民窟，社会纪实摄影的起点。
noteEn: Flash-lit tenements of the New York poor—the dawn of social documentary.

title: 动力车间机械师
creator: Lewis Hine
note: 童工调查摄影师把工人拍成雕像般的英雄，摄影推动了劳动法。
noteEn: The child-labour reformer photographed workers as statuesque heroes—images that helped change labour law.

title: 西贡枪决
creator: Eddie Adams
note: 枪口对准头部的千分之一秒，成为反战浪潮的催化剂。
noteEn: One split second of a pistol at a head—a catalyst of the anti-war movement.

title: 火从天降
creator: Nick Ut
note: 汽油弹中赤身奔逃的女孩，越战最痛的一张照片。
noteEn: A naked girl running from napalm—the most painful image of the Vietnam War.

title: 秃鹫与小女孩
en: The Vulture and the Little Girl
creator: Kevin Carter
note: 饥荒中蹲踞的秃鹫与垂死孩童，获奖后却引来巨大的争议与自责。
noteEn: A vulture waiting beside a starving child—a Pulitzer followed by public outcry and guilt.

title: 毛以后的中国
creator: Liu Heung Shing
note: 改革开放初期的日常面孔，普利策得主留下的第一手中国档案。
noteEn: Everyday faces of China's reform era—a Pulitzer-winning, first-hand archive.

title: 破坏的生意
creator: Don McCullin
note: 战场上的崩溃瞬间，把战争的痛拍到骨头里。
noteEn: Moments of breakdown in war—conflict photographed to the bone.

title: 地狱
creator: James Nachtwey
note: 九年间九场冲突的集结，战地摄影沉重的史诗。
noteEn: Nine conflicts across nine years—a grave epic of photojournalism.

title: 尼加拉瓜
creator: Susan Meiselas
note: 革命与日常交织的中美洲，马格南镜头下的女性视角。
noteEn: Revolution and everyday life in Central America—a Magnum woman's view.

title: 伸手
creator: Larry Burrows
note: 彩色战争摄影的先驱，越战中救护伤员的一组连贯叙事。
noteEn: A pioneer of colour war photography—one wounded soldier's arc through Vietnam.

title: 异教徒
creator: Tim Hetherington
note: 与美军同驻阿富汗山谷，镜头贴近到能听见呼吸。
noteEn: Embedded with US troops in Afghanistan's valley—close enough to hear them breathe.

title: 倒下的士兵
creator: Robert Capa
note: 西班牙内战里士兵中弹倒下的瞬间，战地摄影的传说（真实性常被质疑）。
noteEn: A soldier caught mid-fall in the Spanish Civil War—the legend of war photography, authenticity long debated.

title: 门诺派
creator: Larry Towell
note: 与门诺派同住多年，马格南为封闭社群留下一部影像档案。
noteEn: Years living among the Mennonites—a Magnum archive of a closed community.

title: 矿上
creator: David Goldblatt
note: 南非金矿工的黑与白，种族隔离制度下的劳动与尊严。
noteEn: Black and white of South Africa's gold miners—labour and dignity under apartheid.

title: 病历
creator: Boris Mikhailov
note: 乌克兰后苏联街头的流民，用身体表演自己的绝望。
noteEn: The homeless of post-Soviet Kharkiv, performing their own despair.

title: 广岛
creator: Ishiuchi Miyako
note: 遇难者的衣服、眼镜与鞋的特写，记忆被缝进织物里。
noteEn: Close-ups of victims' garments, glasses and shoes—memory stitched into fabric.

title: 火车上的中国人
creator: Wang Fuchun
note: 绿皮车里三十年的人生百态，流动中国的横向切片。
noteEn: Thirty years of life inside China's hard-seat carriages—a cross-section of a nation in motion.

title: 俺爹俺娘
creator: Jiao Bo
note: 三十年拍父母在乡下的日常，中国乡村亲情最绵长的注脚。
noteEn: Thirty years of a peasant couple's daily life—the longest footnote to Chinese family love.

title: 大眼睛
creator: Xie Hailong
note: 那双「大眼睛」让无数人看见贫困儿童对读书的渴望，成为希望工程的象征。
noteEn: Those "big eyes" made a nation see a poor child's hunger to learn—the symbol of Project Hope.

title: 博帕尔惨案
creator: Raghu Rai
note: 毒气泄漏后的受害者，把工业灾难拍成印度的集体创伤。
noteEn: Victims of the gas leak—an industrial catastrophe rendered as India's collective wound.

title: 9·11 之后
creator: Joel Meyerowitz
note: 获准进入世贸遗址的摄影师，记录下整整一年的清理与重生。
noteEn: Granted rare access to Ground Zero, he documented a full year of recovery and rebirth.

title: 剧场
creator: Hiroshi Sugimoto
note: 一场电影的长曝光，让整个影厅亮成一块白色矩形。
noteEn: A feature-length exposure turns a movie screen into a single white rectangle.

title: 立体模型
creator: Hiroshi Sugimoto
note: 拍博物馆的动物标本布景，以假乱真到开始失真。
noteEn: Museum dioramas photographed until the fake starts to feel real—and then not.

title: 水塔
creator: Bernd & Hilla Becher
note: 网格排列的工业水塔，类型学摄影的圣像。
noteEn: Gridded typologies of industrial water towers—the icon of typological photography.

title: 月亮与墙
creator: Minor White
note: 把月亮、墙面与霜花拍成精神性的抽象，静观即修行。
noteEn: Moon, wall and frost as spiritual abstraction—looking as meditation.

title: 梦游者
creator: Ralph Gibson
note: 身体局部与光影的碎片，超现实的黑白拼图。
noteEn: Fragments of body and light—a surreal monochrome jigsaw.

title: 寻屋
creator: Todd Hido
note: 郊区独栋在夜里的孤光，空旷中渗出不安。
noteEn: Lone suburban houses glowing at night—unease seeping through the emptiness.

title: 假寐
creator: Rinko Kawauchi
note: 日常里瞬间的光，轻柔得几乎无声，却让时间慢下来。
noteEn: Fleeting light in the everyday, soft almost to silence—yet it slows time.

title: 艾拉
creator: Rinko Kawauchi
note: 用轻薄色彩捕捉空气里的浮尘与呼吸，日常如偈语。
noteEn: Dust and breath caught in gossamer colour—the everyday as a Zen phrase.

title: 中空
creator: Masao Yamamoto
note: 小尺寸照片像一页页俳句，留白本身就是禅。
noteEn: Small prints like pages of haiku—emptiness as the point.

title: 砂丘
creator: Shoji Ueda
note: 鸟取砂丘上家人摆成的超现实剪影，像一场被导演的白日梦。
noteEn: Family posed on Tottori's dunes as surreal silhouettes—a staged daydream.

title: 长时间曝光
creator: Michael Wesely
note: 快门开了三年，把施工中的柏林拍成时间的残影。
noteEn: Shutters open for years turn a Berlin construction site into a trace of time.

title: 地面
creator: Uta Barth
note: 模糊的室内光线与角落，让人重新看见「看」本身。
noteEn: Blurred light and corners—making us see seeing itself.

title: 奔跑的白鹿
creator: Paul Caponigro
note: 白鹿在林中瞬间的凝滞，银盐里近乎灵视。
noteEn: A white deer held still in the trees—vision in silver.

title: 自然的艺术形态
creator: Karl Blossfeldt
note: 植物局部的放大特写，成为包豪斯与极简美学的意外灵感。
noteEn: Extreme close-ups of plant forms—an unlikely source of Bauhaus and minimalist aesthetics.
